searchLog: 19th consecutive day of the same environment network-egress failure (logged 2026-09-22 through 2026-10-08, now 2026-10-09 too), and today's run narrowed down exactly how bad it is: WebFetch returned getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for every domain tested except anthropic.com -- boards-api.greenhouse.io, job-boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.ashbyhq.com, jobs.lever.co, stripe.com, www.metacareers.com, www.databricks.com, c3.ai, jobs.generalcatalyst.com, and even www.google.com and openai.com all failed DNS resolution. Only www.anthropic.com/careers/jobs resolved and fetched successfully; its full req list (Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Program Manager, Applied AI Architect) matches target-companies.json's existing verified note that none of these are new-grad-eligible -- FDE/TPM reqs are mid-to-senior, PM reqs are senior, and the Fellows Program is research-only. WebSearch (a separate backend, unaffected by this) surfaced several candidates worth flagging for whoever fixes the allowlist -- C3 AI 'Forward Deployed Engineer, New Grad 2027' (c3.ai), Applied Intuition 'Forward Deployed Engineer - New Grad (December 2026)' (jobs.generalcatalyst.com), and a Palantir New Grad Forward-Deployed Software Engineer listing -- but every one of those domains also failed DNS resolution when fetched, so none could be verified live, eligible, or checked against life/PIPELINE.md for a prior application, and per the hunt's own rule a search snippet is never sufficient grounds to include an opportunity. Zero verified opportunities is the correct and honest output for the 19th straight day running. This is conclusively an environment-level DNS/egress allowlist restricting this routine to anthropic.com only -- not transient, not fixable by retrying tomorrow, and unresolved despite being reported in this exact log every day for over two weeks. It needs a human to widen the egress allowlist for the life-hub-daily hunt routine to cover standard job-board and company-career domains (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, General Catalyst's job board, and plain company .com sites). No conflict between morning-briefing/profile.md and life/PROFILE.md on graduation date this run -- both say December 2026 (life/PROFILE.md shows it was settled by Dom 2026-08-04); the task brief describing this as still-unsettled (Aug-Dec 2026) appears to be a stale instruction that should itself be corrected at the source.
